name: Greyfen Notice Board
greeting: Three missing on the north road. Bram Kett. Sella Vey. Her son Oren.
lines: Payment for an account of the missing and proof of what took them. Names held at the Crow Shrine.
A second hand has added: Bram did not abandon a cart while someone needed it. Ask who closed the road.

variants.greeting: The order beside the contract has been crossed through. The names remain.
lines: Kael: The grain is no longer being held against a signature. Keeping it moving will take more than words.

variants.greeting: A Vargan notice covers half the old contract.
lines: Protected households must attend the renewal. Grain allotments will be recorded beside their assent.
Kael: Hunger does not make an oath freely given.

variants.greeting: Oren's token hangs below the contract. Someone has tied a dry scrap of cloth over it.
lines: Kael: They have not taken it down. Somebody is afraid enough to cover it and kind enough to keep it dry.

variants.greeting: A small note has been added: anyone who saw Bram's cart should speak to Anwen.
lines: Kael: A private account can still invite a second witness.

variants.greeting: The payment remains unclaimed. Beneath it, three empty places for names.
lines: Kael: Keeping the token is not the same as keeping them safe.

actions.label: I will find what happened to Bram, Sella, and Oren.
